title: Consolidation & Unclear Conditions

launchpad.outcome: Separate “does ICC exist?” from “do I participate in this condition?”, and write your environment rule.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Is price clear enough for my rules?

asks.prompt: Overlap, close-through, close-back, close-through, multiple PIL candidates, tiny ICC-looking sequences. What’s the honest read?

options.label: A technical sequence in a low-quality environment
options.why: It may not make the strategy invalid. Your environment filter may still say PASS.

options.label: The strategy is broken
options.feedback: The strategy is fine. The condition is unclear.

lines: Do I participate in this condition?

slides.title: Your consolidation / environment rule
slides.punch: Example: “I do not take Dayli ICC setups inside tight consolidation when structural direction and PIL relevance are unclear.” Yours can differ.

lines: YOU DO NOT NEED TO BECOME

slides.quote: Chop doesn’t break the method. It just doesn’t give you much to read.

slides.prompt: When does your environment rule say PASS?
slides.modelAnswer: When the structure is too unclear for me to name the PIL and the direction without forcing it, like tight consolidation with competing levels. The setup can look technical and I still pass.

remember: IF PRICE IS CONFUSED, YOU DON’T NEED TO BE MORE CONFIDENT THAN THE CHART.
